It cannot effectively audit 'missing' limbs/bodies as it requires existing structures to detect. The 'topology_boundary_auditor' is better suited to define the boundary of the rabbit heads and confirm they do not connect to any body segments.

If the chairs span the width, they are not strictly 'to the left'. The reasoning is acceptable, but the 'geometric_depth_auditor' should specifically output a depth map to confirm if the rabbits are indeed 'behind' the motorcycles (Atom 6), as the current plan relies on visual inspection which failed to notice the fusion.
